name: Python Number Guess
description:
Classic number guessing game in Python.

   Computer: I'm thinking of a number...
   You: Is it 50?
   Computer: Too high!
   You: Is it 25?
   Computer: You got it! :tada:

Great first Python project. Learn: input(), if/else, loops.

fields.label: Your name
fields.help: Shown in the welcome and victory messages.

fields.label: Difficulty
fields.help: Easy: 1-50 with 10 guesses. Normal: 1-100 with 7 guesses. Hard: 1-200 with 5 guesses.
